D: An absent-minded professor invents a bouncing green goo and forgets his own wedding, again.
P: Serve dessert when the flubber starts dancing around the house.
S: Avocado, peas, lime, mint and feta blended green, with crisp pita wedges
Avocado, peas, lime, mint and feta blitzed bright green, served with pita crisps and sugar snap peas.
Baked choux puffs with cheddar and a pinch of paprika

Choux pastry with cheddar and paprika piped into small balls, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow. Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour until smooth, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time. Stir in 100g grated cheddar and a pinch of paprika. Pipe small balls onto trays and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow.
the basketball game with the flubber shoes

Little beef meatballs baked crisp and rolled in a sticky honey barbecue glaze, speared on picks and served with a cool ranch dip for the bench. Mix 500g beef mince with 40g breadcrumbs, an egg, a grated garlic clove and salt. Roll into 30 small balls and bake on a lined tray at 200C for 15 minutes. Simmer 150ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey for 3 minutes and toss the meatballs through. Mix 150g sour cream with 1 tbsp mayonnaise, chopped chives, dill and garlic powder for the dip.
M: Lemon thyme chicken with baby potatoes
Roast lemon thyme chicken breasts, baby potatoes and buttered green beans
Chicken breasts roasted at 200C with lemon and thyme, served with buttered potatoes and green beans, the dinner he should have been at.

Thin crisp bases spread with basil pesto, loaded with mozzarella, cherry tomatoes, mushrooms and capsicum, finished with rocket and parmesan. Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases on oiled trays. Spread each with 3 tbsp basil pesto. Top with 250g grated mozzarella, 150g halved cherry tomatoes, 100g sliced mushrooms and half a sliced green capsicum. Bake at 250C for 10 minutes until blistered. Scatter with rocket and shaved parmesan and cut into squares.
W: Firm lime jelly set in a ring mould and turned out wobbling
Lime jelly set in a ring mould, turned out wobbling onto a plate with whipped cream and kiwifruit.
K: Lime cordial and lemonade with a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on top

Lime cordial and lemonade with a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on top in tall glasses. Pour a splash of lime cordial into tall glasses and top with cold lemonade. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it floats and foams up green. Serve straight away with a long spoon and a straw before it bubbles over like an experiment.

steps.text: Toss the potatoes with half the olive oil and the salt and roast at 200C for 35 minutes.
Toss the haloumi with the lemon juice, thyme and the rest of the oil.
Fry the haloumi in a hot pan until golden on both sides.
Steam the beans and toss with the potatoes, haloumi and butter.

s.note: Avocado, peas, lime, mint and feta blended green, with crisp pita wedges
s.how: Blitz 2 avocados with 200g thawed peas, the juice of 2 limes, a handful of mint and 100g feta until smooth and very green. Cut pita bread into wedges, brush with oil and bake until crisp. Serve the goo with the crisps and some sugar snap peas.

m.n: Lemon thyme chicken with baby potatoes
m.note: Roast lemon thyme chicken breasts, baby potatoes and buttered green beans
m.how: Rub 4 chicken breasts with lemon juice, thyme, oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 20 minutes with 800g halved baby potatoes started 20 minutes earlier. Steam green beans and toss everything with butter. The dinner he should have been at, three times over.

w.note: Firm lime jelly set in a ring mould and turned out wobbling
w.how: Make up 3 packets of lime jelly with a little less water than the packet says so it holds its shape. Pour into a ring mould and chill overnight. Dip the mould briefly in hot water and turn out wobbling onto a plate. Fill the centre with cream and sliced kiwifruit.
